description: For rationals p and q, inclusion of their lower cuts is equivalent to p at most q, and proper inclusion is equivalent to p less than q.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower_order (p q : ℚ) :
  (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower p ⊆
        Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower q ↔
      p ≤ q) ∧
    (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower p ⊂
        Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower q ↔
      p < q)
